structure.title: Glow: Generative Flowwith Invertible 1×\times1 Convolutions
structure.abstract: AbstractFlow-based generative models(Dinh et al.,, 2014)are conceptually attractive due to tractability of the exact log-likelihood, tractability of exact latent-variable inference, and parallelizability of both training and synthesis. In this paper we proposeGlow, a simple type of generative flow using an invertible1×11\times 1convolution. Using our method we demonstrate a significant improvement in log-likelihood on standard benchmarks. Perhaps most strikingly, we demonstrate that a generative model optimized towards the plain log-likelihood objective is capable of efficient realistic-looking synthesis and manipulation of large images. The code for our model is available athttps://github.com/openai/glow.
